title.en: Find the real door first: don't open an account on a fake platform
title.zh-Hans: 先认门，再注册：别把账户开在假平台

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E04' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第04集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Two near-identical doors. One says 'HUGE REWARDS'; the other clearly lists the service provider and the rules.
shots.visual_zh: 两扇外观相似的门：一扇写“超高奖励”，另一扇写清服务主体与规则。

text.en: This one has a huge reward. I'll just go in here?
text.zh-Hans: 这个奖励特别高，我就从这扇门进去？

shots.source_visual_zh: 两扇外观相似的门：一扇写“超高奖励”，另一扇写清服务主体与规则。

shots.visual_en: Nexubo deals out four check cards: Region, Service provider, Fees & deposits/withdrawals, Account security.
shots.visual_zh: 小纳展示四张核对卡：地区、服务主体、费用与出入金、账户安全。

text.en: Don't let a reward decide. First check: is this allowed where you live? Does the platform accept your real country of residence? Which company provides the service? Then look at fees, deposits and withdrawal rules.
text.zh-Hans: 先别被奖励决定。先查当地是否允许、平台是否接受你的真实居住地区、由哪个主体提供服务，再看费用、入金和提现条件。

shots.source_visual_zh: 小纳展示四张核对卡：地区、服务主体、费用与出入金、账户安全。

shots.visual_en: Sign-up from a verified official page. Highlight three areas: email, unique password, verification flow. Address bar shows the verified domain with a check.
shots.visual_zh: 从已核验的官方页面进入注册；突出邮箱、独立密码、验证流程三个区域。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Sign up on the verified page

text.en: Once you've confirmed the official entry, sign up with your own email or phone number, set a unique password, and complete the checks the page asks for. Never buy someone else's account, and never fake your identity or region.
text.zh-Hans: 确认官方入口后，再用自己的邮箱或手机号注册，设置独立密码，完成页面要求的验证。不要购买别人的账户，也不要虚构身份和地区。

shots.source_visual_zh: 从已核验的官方页面进入注册；突出邮箱、独立密码、验证流程三个区域。

shots.visual_en: Security panel lights up one by one: unique password, passkey or authenticator app, device check.
shots.visual_zh: 安全面板依次点亮独立密码、通行密钥或验证器、设备检查。

text.en: Signing up isn't the last step. Turn on the security features the platform supports, check your logged-in devices, and save your recovery options. And never send a one-time code to a so-called support agent.
text.zh-Hans: 注册不是最后一步。把平台支持的安全措施设置好，检查登录设备，保存恢复方式。一次性验证码也不能发给所谓的客服代办。

shots.source_visual_zh: 安全面板依次点亮独立密码、通行密钥或验证器、设备检查。

shots.visual_en: A platform comparison table with a 'Partner' label that stays visible; an unknown region shows 'Pending verification'.
shots.visual_zh: 平台比较表上“推广合作”标签一直可见；未知地区状态显示待核实。

text.en: Our site can help you look things up, but a partnership is not a safety guarantee. If the facts aren't confirmed, don't start the sign-up.
text.zh-Hans: 我们的网站可以帮助你查信息，但推广关系不等于安全担保。资料未确认时，先不进入开户流程。

shots.source_visual_zh: 平台比较表上“推广合作”标签一直可见；未知地区状态显示待核实。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'High reward, but your region isn't supported. Keep signing up, or stop?' Nexubo antenna turns red with a short ding, red chip 'Region not supported'; then green when Sam answers.
shots.visual_zh: 问题卡：奖励很高但地区不受支持，继续注册还是停止？天线先变红并“叮”一声，红色警示条“地区不支持”；小白答对后转绿。

text.en: Stop. Confirm eligibility and the rules first.
text.zh-Hans: 停止，先确认资格和规则。

text.en: Right. Find the real door, then open the account.

question.en: High reward, but your region isn't supported. Keep signing up, or stop?
question.zh-Hans: 奖励很高，但你的地区不支持。继续注册，还是停下？

shots.source_visual_zh: 问题卡：奖励很高但地区不受支持，继续注册还是停止？天线先变红并“叮”一声，红色警示条“地区不支持”；小白答对后转绿。

cta.en: Find the verified official door first.
cta.zh-Hans: 先找到核实过的官方入口。

disclosure.en: Partner link · the exchange pays our commission
disclosure.zh-Hans: 合作推广链接 · 佣金由交易所支付

text.en: Want a door you can trust? NexuAlpha lists each exchange's verified official link. Our OKX partner link goes straight to the official site, and code nexu888 adds a fee rebate.
text.zh-Hans: 想要一扇可信的门？NexuAlpha 列出每家交易所核验过的官方入口。我们的 OKX 合作链接直达官网，填写邀请码 nexu888 还能享受手续费返还。

conversion_card.visual_en: Conversion card (6 s): clean NexuAlpha card slides in from the right; text only (exchange name as text, no exchange logo artwork, no fake clickable button, no QR to an unverified page). Disclosure line sits on the card itself, at least 70% of subtitle size. No reward amount, no percentage, no date. Nexubo beside the card, thumbs-up, antenna green. For restricted locales swap to the restricted_variant (official-site link only).
conversion_card.visual_zh: 转化卡（6秒）：NexuAlpha卡片从右侧滑入；只用文字写交易所名称，不放交易所标志图，不画假按钮，不放未核验二维码。披露语印在卡片上，字号不小于字幕的70%。不出现奖励金额、百分比和日期。小纳在旁点赞，天线绿灯。受限语种改用 restricted_variant（只给官网链接）。

source_line.en: Want a door you can trust? NexuAlpha lists each exchange's verified official link. Our OKX partner link goes straight to the official site, and code nexu888 adds a fee rebate.
source_line.zh-Hans: 想要一扇可信的门？NexuAlpha 列出每家交易所核验过的官方入口。我们的 OKX 合作链接直达官网，填写邀请码 nexu888 还能享受手续费返还。

source_availability.en: Availability depends on your country or region
source_availability.zh-Hans: 是否可用取决于你所在的国家或地区

restricted_variant.line_en: NexuAlpha lists each exchange's verified official site, so you can check the address before you sign up.
restricted_variant.line_zh: NexuAlpha 列出每家交易所核验过的官网地址，注册前先核对网址。
restricted_variant.note: No invite code, no rebate wording, no disclosure needed because no partner link is shown.

text.en: Do it now: turn on two-factor login. Then come back. Next, someone in a chat offers to 'do your KYC for you'.
text.zh-Hans: 现在就做：打开两步验证。然后回来——下一集，有人在聊天里说能替你代办认证。

text.en: Do it now: turn on two-factor login. Then come back. Next, someone in a chat offers to 'do your KYC for you'.
text.zh-Hans: 现在就做：打开两步验证。然后回来——下一集，有人在聊天里说能替你代办认证。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Check region eligibility, the official entry and the fees first; then sign up and turn on security settings.
goal.zh-Hans: 知道先查地区资格、官方入口与费用，再注册并启用安全设置。

page_cta.line_en: Checked your region? Open OKX through our verified partner link. Code nexu888 is applied.
page_cta.line_zh: 确认了所在地区？通过我们核验过的 OKX 合作链接注册，自动带上邀请码 nexu888。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson
page_cta.disclosure_en: Partner link · the exchange pays our commission
page_cta.disclosure_zh: 合作推广链接 · 佣金由交易所支付
page_cta.restricted_behavior: show neutral 'official site' link only (exchange profile page), no code, no rebate wording

exercise.task_en: In a mock platform profile, find the unsupported region, the abnormal entry link and the undisclosed fees.
exercise.task_zh: 在虚拟平台资料卡里找出地区不支持、入口异常和未披露费用。
exercise.answer_en: If any key eligibility or entry problem is unresolved, do not continue.
exercise.answer_zh: 任一关键资格或入口问题未解决，都不应继续。

red_lines: Never claim a licence covers the whole world or guarantees your money ｜ 不声称某牌照覆盖全球或担保本金
Real tutorials must show the actual entry, region and verification date at that time ｜ 正式教程需展示当时真实入口、地区及核验日期
The 'Partner' label stays visible whenever a partner is shown ｜ 出现合作平台时“推广合作”标签始终可见

Conversion card: no reward amounts, percentages or dates in the video; disclosure on the card; restricted locales (ru/ar/zh-Hant/ur/uk/vi/ja/ko) get the neutral official-site variant ｜ 转化卡不写奖励金额、百分比、日期；卡片上必须有披露语；受限语种只给官网中性链接
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
